coastal.title: B.C. man who went missing in mountains for several days found alive
coastal.description: Stanislav Volo went for a hike on Sunday above the Sea-to-Sky Gondola and did not return home.

coastal.title: Friend holds out hope for Canadian runner missing on Matterhorn
coastal.description: A friend of a Canadian athlete who went missing on the Matterhorn says Squamish, B.C.'s mountain running community is hoping for her safe return.

coastal.title: Why Vancouver Island municipalities are maintaining campfire bans through the Labour Day long weekend
coastal.description: A number of municipalities in the Greater Victoria area are maintaining campfire bans through the Labour Day long weekend, even as campfire bans on areas outside municipal boundaries have lifted throughout B.C.

coastal.title: Helicopter search suspended for Squamish, B.C., mountain runner missing on Matterhorn
coastal.description: The helicopter search for Canadian mountain runner Kalie McCrystal, who was last seen on Tuesday above the Jean-Antoine Carrel hut of the Matterhorn, has been suspended after repeated aerial sweeps of the Italian side of the mountain.

kamloops.title: Kamloops officials ask for public's help after man attacked by 2 dogs
kamloops.description: Eric Dean said he was walking along the riverside trail near his business, Kamloops Precision Machining in the Valleyview neighbourhood, around lunchtime on Wednesday when the attack happened.

northwest.title: B.C. expanding supports for intimate partner violence survivors, including family court worker in northwest
northwest.description: At least one of three new family court support workers will be assigned to northwestern B.C. as the province uses $3 million in funding under Ottawa's National Action Plan to End Gender-based Violence.

southeast.title: Golden, B.C., to align with Pacific time zone after final November clock change
southeast.description: Time is changing in Golden, B.C., and some residents say it is not what they wanted.
